session.title: Kiara Enduro/DH repeatability - 3 plus earned 4th
session.purpose: Build Kiara enduro repeatability while protecting Saturday PCP quality by making the fourth Twin Peaks climb conditional on execution quality rather than motivation.

dose.terrain: Bukit Kiara / Twin Peaks route family
dose.primary_work: Three Twin Peaks climbs: two Enduro-stage simulation descents and one DH-line descent.
dose.optional_work: Fourth Twin Peaks climb plus DH-line descent only if all execution gates are passed after the third descent.
dose.cap: Hard cap 180 minutes elapsed and four climbs; no fifth climb, no extra descent, no segment chasing.
dose.climb_target: RPE 3-5 / mostly Z2-Z3; steep pitches may be pushed but no sustained threshold climbing.
dose.descent_target: Race-line attention at 85-90% aggression, with clean braking and no late-ride survival riding.
dose.setup_variable: Keep Zeb baseline fixed: 65 psi, rebound 4 clicks from closed, HSC 2 clicks from closed, LSC 5 clicks from closed.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Three controlled climb-to-descent cycles should reinforce repeatable stage execution; a fourth cycle is useful only if technical quality remains stable and does not compromise Saturday PCP jump-line work.
execution_rules: Wear the external HR strap and confirm the ride is tagged to the Enduro.
Run the two Enduro-stage simulations first while lines and braking are sharp.
Use the third descent on the DH line as the quality gate, not as proof that more is automatically better.
Earn the fourth climb only if climb-three RPE is 5/10 or lower, braking timing is still deliberate, vision is wide, no arm pump is building, and fuel/hydration are on schedule.
If the fourth is earned, ride the climb aerobic and descend at 85-90%, not maximum pace.

expected_result.garmin_load: moderate-to-meaningful MTB load; likely 160-230 for three quality climbs and higher if the fourth is earned
expected_result.next_day: still able to do PCP quality reps without heavy legs, arm pump hangover, or braking sloppiness
expected_result.technical_result: Lap-to-lap descent quality remains stable, especially braking release timing, corner exits, and root composure.

stop_rules: No fourth climb if climb-three RPE is above 5/10, breathing is no longer controlled, or heat is driving sloppy choices.
Stop descending hard if braking gets late, vision narrows, line choice becomes reactive, or front-end confidence fades.
Abort the fourth if fuel or fluid intake has lagged behind plan.
End the session immediately for crash, near-crash, mechanical issue, sharp pain, or repeated mistakes.
